notes.text: M0: regime likely loose (price cuts news, spot 1.08x idx). launch unknown 11-18 prior. brokers unknown. growth unknown. Plan: buy H early via vendor, add power, probe broker A, small spot for window1.
M1: loose likely (spot ~1.07x idx, idx drift up slightly 2.7% though). Window1 on track without spot. Adding power for later H/N. Broker A pending.

M2: news loose, idx down 5%, but spot 1.6x idx (noise?). Launch rumour ~18 => likely 16-18. Broker A delivered 1/1 (lean reliable). Growth ~5% so far, unclear. Plan: hold, buy more H ~month 5-8 for window3.
M3: shipment only 2.29k + idx +6% => likely TIGHT now. Launch ~18. Broker A 1/1. Growth ~6-9%? lean 7%. Plan: queue more vendor H now (slow in tight), use broker A for top-ups later.
M4: shipment 6.9k, idx -6%, spot ~1.04x => LOOSE (regime flips?). Launch ~18. Broker A 1/1. Growth ~4-6% unclear. H total will be 40k
M5: mixed signals (idx +6%, tight-ish news) - regime uncertain, lean loose. Launch ~18. Broker A 1/1 reliable-lean. Growth ~5%. Window1 should complete m6-7 once 30MW energises. Hold.

M6: window1 completes this month. Regime unclear (idx -9% suggests loose, news tight). Launch ~18. Growth ~5%. Will have 40k H and 66MW from m7 - surplus in window2. Window3 needs ~15-20 kH extra plus power after m19. Hold.

M7: window1 done (64.8). Idx -8% => loose. Export-control rumour (affects spot/alloc). Launch ~18 (16-20). Growth est ~5%/mo avg. 40k H powered covers window2 with surplus. Window3 plan: ~15 kH extra via reservations/spot or gen N, plus power after m19. Hold.

M8: rumours 18 then 15 => launch likely 16-17. Loose (idx drifting down, HBM loosens). Growth ~4-5%. Window2 has ~13 kH/mo surplus - resell 3k H/mo for 2 months before launch haircut. Window3 via gen N at launch + reservations/spot after launch price cut.
M9: idx +4% and tight news - regime maybe tight now. Launch 16-17. Growth ~5%. Window2 needs 15.9/mo for 7 months, have ~28 surplus. Resell 3k more H.

M10: inventory-building news, idx -6% => loose. Launch 16-17. Growth ~5-6%. Window2 needs 14.3/mo for 6 months - resell 3k more H (to 31k). Plan: sign ~10MW power ~m12, buy gen N at launch, spot/reservations for months 16-19.

M11: rumour 18 again => launch 16-17 (intersection of 18+-2 and 15+-2). Spot 1.9x idx this month - maybe tight blip. Growth ~5%. Keep 31k H (window2 fine at ~12.6/mo needed). Sign 10MW for gen N after m19.

M12: idx -2.6% loose-ish, HBM loosens. Export-control rumour again. Launch 16-17. Inference flat ~7.7-8.6 => growth maybe 3%. Window2 needs ~10/mo for 4 months - fine. Hold, plan gen N order at launch.

M13: export controls in effect m13-18 (H alloc 40pct, spot 60pct). Regime loose (idx -6%, CoWoS news). Launch 16-17. Inference 9.2 => growth ~5%, maybe switched up. Window2 completes this month. Window3 deficit ~170 kH-mo: plan reserve ~10kH at m15, gen N vendor+broker at launch, spot top-up.

M14: window2 met. Rumour 17 => launch 16-17 still. Loose (idx +4.5% noise, price-cut news). Growth ~4-5%. Plan: at m15 reserve ~10kH 6m for m16-21, order gen N at launch (vendor + broker A), spot top-ups.

M15: no vendor launch confirmation => launch likely m17 (P16 ~1/6). Loose (inventory news, spot <idx). Growth ~5%. Window3 deficit ~19-20 kH/mo in m16-19. Reserve 10kH 6m now (m16-21), spot from m16, gen N vendor ~8k + broker A 4k at launch.

M16: no launch at 16, no confirmation, but rumours (18,15,18,17) pin it to 16-17 => expect m17. Spot 3.5 (2.6x idx), idx +7% => maybe TIGHT now. Growth ~4%. Window3: ~31 training/mo now, need ~45/mo in m19-23. Sign 15MW for gen N. Skip spot at 3.5. If launch m17: N vendor + brokers A/B. If not: H via brokers.

M17: gen N LAUNCHED m17. Inference 11.5 => growth likely switched to ~7%. Regime unclear (rival buying, idx fell 25pct from launch). Broker A 1/1 but may have decayed. Window3 needs 290.5 in m17-23 (41.5/mo). Cheapest = 6m reservations at 1.1 (m18-23), then broker A N (usable m19), vendor N (m20+), spot top-up.

M18: idx +8% but spot only 1.15x idx, quiet news - regime uncertain. Launch done m17. Inference ~10.7-11.5, growth ~5-7%. Broker A N order pending. Need 260 in 6 months (43.4/mo). Spot 5 this month at 1.2, reserve 5 more as hedge vs broker failure / tight N allocation.
M19: broker A delivered 2/2 (reliable, no sign of decay). HBM loosens - lean loose. Growth ~6-7% (12.1). Need 216 in 5 months (43.3/mo)
M20: vendor N shipping (3.4k) - loose-ish. Broker A reliable. Growth ~7pct (13.4). Need 165.6 in 4 months, projected ~217. Resell 3k surplus H (resale beats end mark slightly).
M21: N shipment 1.6k + tight news => maybe tight. Growth ~5-7pct. Need 111 in 3 months, projected ~150. Resell 3k more H, keep margin ~30.
M22: loose news, spot <idx. Growth ~5pct. Need 56.6 in 2 months, projected ~90. Resell 3k H and 2k N (resale slightly beats end mark), keep margin ~20.
M23: loose. Need 18.1 this month, capacity leaves ~37 for training. Resell 3k H and 3k N (still ~28 training, margin ~10).
